content.short: Pudgy Cat is a community Cardano project with a native metaverse currency and on-chain NFT collections.
content.description: Pudgy Cat is a vibrant, community-driven project on the Cardano blockchain that combines meme culture with practical metaverse utility. The project features the $PUDGY token, designed as a primary currency for future virtual worlds, including the Pudgy Dome Art Gallery. Holders of Pudgy Cat NFTs, which are minted entirely on-chain for permanent storage, receive exclusive rewards and discounts on future collections. By blending artistic collectibles with a long-term ecosystem vision, Pudgy Cat fosters a dedicated community of creators and enthusiasts within the Cardano landscape.
